description: Set a monthly qualified-install cap of at least 10,000 and its alert email. Pass null for both values to clear the cap. Requires a workspace-scoped write key.

alert_email.description: Email address for the cap's alerts, at most 320 characters, or null to clear the cap (monthly_qualified_install_cap must then be null too).

idempotency_key.description: Stable retry key for this exact mutation.

monthly_qualified_install_cap.description: Monthly qualified-install cap, a whole number of at least 10,000, or null to clear the cap (alert_email must then be null too). Once the cap is exceeded, additional install charges stop for the rest of the billing period.

name: set_usage_cap
title: Set the workspace usage cap
